deprecated_yaml.title: The Prix Carburant YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring Prix Carburant with the `prix_carburant` sensor platform in configuration.yaml is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Your stations are still imported at each start.

To configure the integration from the UI: remove the platform from configuration.yaml, restart Home Assistant, delete the Prix Carburant integration and add it again. Set the maximum distance to 0 to only use your own stations, then add them from the options of the integration.
